items.Sentence: Preliminary treatment consists of screens
Preliminary treatment consists of screens followed by grit removal
An iron salts dosing station doses ferric chloride at the Emergency Basin Overflow Structure for odor control
wastewater is pumped into rectangular primary clarifiers
advanced secondary treatment with an activated sludge process configured and operated for biological nutrient removal (BNR)
designed to remove BOD and ammonia (NH3) in the same aeration basins
The first and third quads are operated under anoxic conditions...partial denitrification
Following biological treatment, the wastewater flows by gravity to secondary clarifiers
The wastewater undergoes filtration. There are 16 separate mono media filters
16 million gallons of storage used for daily flow equalization after the primary clarifiers
Filter backwash water is sent to a backwash equalization basin for storage, followed by flocculation
Filter backwash water...followed by flocculation and sedimentation
Sodium hypochlorite and ammonia are metered into the filter effluent...to produce a solution of chloramines for disinfection
an appropriate amount of sodium bisulfite is added to neutralize the hypochlorite
Sludge...is processed using Temperature Phased Anaerobic Digestion (TPAD) with thermophilic and mesophilic anaerobic digesters
The process consists of...dissolved air flotation (DAF) thickening of primary and secondary sludges
Digested sludge then undergoes...dewatering using open air drying beds
Digested sludge then undergoes either lagoon stabilization and dewatering using open air drying beds
mechanical dewatering using centrifuges (once the new biosolids dewatering facility is complete)
This project will build a new digested sludge dewatering facility, including...polymer storage and dosing equipment
Dewatered biosolids are used...land applied as a soil amendment
Dewatered biosolids are used as alternative daily cover at a landfill
Dewatered biosolids...processed further into a compost or fertilizer
Silicon Valley Advanced Water Purification Center...treating up to 10 MGD of the Facility’s secondary effluent using microfiltration
capable of treating up to 10 MGD...using...reverse osmosis
capable of treating up to 10 MGD...and ultraviolent light disinfection
